label: D2: a1 led rarely to S2 after a rewarded trial, late in episode
explanation: Fires only at D2, only when the agent chose a1 and reached S2 (a rare transition), and only when the previous trial was rewarded (input reward 0 at D2, in_action 1, in_state 2). Every activation satisfies D2 & a1 & S2 & prev_reward==1, but that alone gives precision 0.14. Activity is restricted to late episode (ep_trial >= ~75, mostly 80-99; none before 70), which raises precision to 0.67. Excluding cases where the previous trial was itself an a2 choice or reached S2 (e.g. a second consecutive rare S2) gives dev F1 0.80, mass recall 0.98 (test F1 0.78). Mostly occurs while S1 is good (a1 is the good choice), value low. Misses are weak activations (ep_trial 70-79 or after a previous rare). About 30% of predicted steps stay silent, with no clean further condition found. Never fires at D1/GO, after a2, at S1, or after an unrewarded trial. All variables are observable at D2 except ep_trial, which the agent can only track implicitly (time in episode).
